t2.title: Handwritten letters more meaningful than digital messages
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Are handwritten letters more meaningful than digital messages?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Budget Airlines: Bargain or Burden?

As someone who frequently travels on a tight budget, I've had plenty of experience with budget carriers. Are they worth it? Let me share my honest thoughts.

Undoubtedly, the initial ticket prices are attractive. For short-haul flights, saving 50-70% compared to traditional airlines makes budget carriers appealing.

However, the hidden costs can quickly erode those savings. Baggage fees, seat selection, and onboard refreshments add up surprisingly fast.

Moreover, comfort compromises are real. Tight seats, no entertainment, and minimal service can make longer flights particularly uncomfortable.

Personally, I recommend budget airlines for flights under three hours where you can travel light. For longer journeys, the price difference often isn't worth the discomfort.

My tip? Always calculate the total cost including extras before booking!

What's your budget airline experience?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi SkyBudget,


The plane is okay. The people are okay. Food no good. Bye.
t2.sampleA2:
Dear SkyBudget,


Thank you for the flight. It was okay. The booking was easy, and the check-in was fast. But the food was not good. The people on the plane were nice. I think you need better food. Maybe I will fly with you again because it is cheap.


Thanks,


Sardor Xolmatov
t2.sampleB1:
Dear SkyBudget,


I am writing to you about my recent flight. Overall, it was an okay experience, but there are some things you could improve.


The booking process online was very easy, and I didn't have any problems checking in. The cabin crew were mostly helpful, but some of them seemed a bit stressed. I think they need more training.


The main problem was the lack of space on the plane. It was very uncomfortable, especially for a longer flight. Also, the food was not very good. I think you should offer better food options.


If you improved these things, I would definitely choose SkyBudget again because the price is good. Thank you for your time.


Sincerely,


Sardor Xolmatov
t2.sampleB2:
The Lost Art of the Handwritten Letter

In a world where we fire off dozens of messages a day, when was the last time you actually sat down and wrote a letter by hand? For me, nothing beats the feeling of finding an envelope with my name on it in the post.

Digital messages are undeniably convenient. They travel across the globe in seconds and keep us connected around the clock. Yet, precisely because they are so effortless, they often feel throwaway. A quick text is here one minute and buried under a hundred others the next, forgotten almost as soon as it arrives.

A handwritten letter, on the other hand, is a different story. Someone has taken the time to choose their words, and their handwriting carries a personal touch that no font can match. Years later, you can still hold that letter in your hands and be taken straight back to the moment.

In my view, both have their place, but when it comes to saying something that truly matters, a handwritten letter wins hands down. So next time, why not pick up a pen and surprise someone you care about?
t2.uzSample:
Arzon Aviakompaniyalar: Foydami yoki Yuk?

Tejamkorlik bilan tez-tez sayohat qiladigan odam sifatida, men arzon aviakompaniyalar bilan ko'p tajribaga egaman. Ular arziydimi? Keling, o'z fikrlarimni siz bilan baham ko'rsam.

Shubhasiz, dastlabki chipta narxlari jozibali. Qisqa masofali reyslar uchun an'anaviy aviakompaniyalarga nisbatan 50-70% tejash arzon aviakompaniyalarni jozibador qiladi.

Biroq, yashirin xarajatlar bu tejashni tezda yo'qqa chiqarishi mumkin. Yuk to'lovlari, o'rindiq tanlash va bortdagi ichimliklar hayratlanarli darajada tez qo'shiladi.

Bundan tashqari, qulaylikdagi murosalar haqiqat. Tor o'rindiqlar, ko'ngilochar dasturlar yo'qligi va minimal xizmat uzoqroq reyslarni ayniqsa noqulay qilishi mumkin.

Shaxsan men, agar siz yengil sayohat qila olsangiz, uch soatdan kam bo'lgan reyslar uchun arzon aviakompaniyalarni tavsiya qilaman. Uzoqroq sayohatlar uchun narx farqi ko'pincha noqulaylikka arzimaydi.

Mening maslahatim? Bron qilishdan oldin har doim qo'shimcha xarajatlarni ham hisobga olgan holda umumiy narxni hisoblang!

Sizning arzon aviakompaniyalar bilan tajribangiz qanday?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom, SkyBudget,


Samolyot yaxshi. Odamlar yaxshi. Ovqat yaxshi emas. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli SkyBudget,


Parvoz uchun rahmat. Yaxshi bo'ldi. Bron qilish oson edi va ro'yxatdan o'tish tez bo'ldi. Ammo ovqat yaxshi emas edi. Samolyotdagi odamlar yaxshi edi. O'ylashimcha, sizga yaxshiroq ovqat kerak. Ehtimol, siz bilan yana uchaman, chunki arzon.


Rahmat,


Sardor Xolmatov
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SkyBudget,


Men sizga yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan reysim haqida yozmoqdaman. Umuman olganda, bu yaxshi tajriba edi, lekin siz yaxshilashingiz mumkin bo'lgan ba'zi narsalar bor.


Onlayn bron qilish jarayoni juda oson edi va ro'yxatdan o'tishda hech qanday muammoga duch kelmadim. Kabina ekipaji asosan yordam berishdi, lekin ularning ba'zilari biroz stressda ko'rindi. Menimcha, ularga ko'proq trening kerak.


Asosiy muammo samolyotda joyning yetishmasligi edi. Bu juda noqulay edi, ayniqsa uzoqroq reys uchun. Bundan tashqari, ovqat juda yaxshi emas edi. Menimcha, siz yaxshiroq ovqat variantlarini taklif qilishingiz kerak.


Agar siz bu narsalarni yaxshilasangiz, men narx yaxshi bo'lgani uchun SkyBudgetni yana tanlagan bo'lardim. Vaqtingiz uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,


Sardor Xolmatov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SkyBudget mijozlar bilan aloqalar bo'limi,


Men SkyBudget bilan yaqinda amalga oshirgan parvozim haqida fikr-mulohazalar bildirish uchun yozyapman. Narx, albatta, jozibali bo'lsa-da, tajribaning bir nechta jihatlari yaxshilanishga muhtoj.


Onlayn bron qilish jarayoni sodda va samarali edi. Ro'yxatdan o'tish ham nisbatan muammosiz kechdi, garchi yuk topshirish joyidagi navbat juda uzun edi. Kabina ekipaji odatda xushmuomala va yordam beruvchi edi, garchi ularning parvoz davomida mavjudligi cheklangan ko'rinardi.


Mening asosiy tashvishim umumiy qulaylik bilan bog'liq. O'rindiqlar tor edi, oyoq uchun joy minimal edi va parvoz davomida ko'ngilochar variantlarning yo'qligi sayohatni ancha uzoqroq qildi. Bundan tashqari, yuk va o'rindiq tanlash uchun qo'shimcha to'lovlar umumiy xarajatni sezilarli darajada oshirdi va dastlabki narx afzalligini kamaytirdi.


Qayta biznesni rag'batlantirish uchun SkyBudgetga qulayroq o'rindiqlarga sarmoya kiritishni va bepul asosiy ko'ngilochar variantlarni o'rganishni taklif qilaman. Kamroq yashirin to'lovlar bilan yanada shaffof narxlash tuzilishi ham mijozlar tajribasini yaxshilaydi. Raqobatbardosh narxlarni saqlab qolish zarurligini tushunsam ham, yo'lovchilarning qulayligiga e'tibor bermaslik va qo'shimcha to'lovlar undirish oxir-oqibatda qabul qilinadigan qiymatni pasaytiradi.


Hurmat bilan,


Sardor Xolmatov

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is planning to book with the same airline. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! So I flew with SkyBudget last week. The flight was actually fine, but honestly, the extra fees for everything add up! Make sure you check the baggage allowance before booking. Let me know if you need tips!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Kamron,
SkyBudget is okay. The plane is okay. But money! Baggage is extra. Bye!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Kamron,
I flew with SkyBudget. It was okay, but it was not cheap. The bags cost extra money, and the food too. You should check the prices before you book it because it is not all included. Bye!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Kamron,
I wanted to tell you about SkyBudget. The flight itself was fine, but you have to pay extra for everything. For example, baggage and even food cost extra. I think you should compare the prices carefully with other airlines before you book, because the final price might be higher than you expect. Let me know if you have any questions!
t11.sampleB2:
Hi Kamron,
Heard you're planning to book with SkyBudget — I flew with them last week! Honestly, the flight was fine and pretty cheap, but the extra fees really add up. Make sure you check the baggage allowance before you book, or you'll get stung at the airport. Shop around first, and let me know if you need any tips!

Take care,
Dilnoza Karimova

Oxir-oqibat, u ko'ringanidek arzon bo'lmasligi mumkin. Umid qilamanki, bu yordam beradi!

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the airline. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear SkyBudget Customer Relations,

Thank you for the opportunity to provide feedback on my recent flight.

Firstly, the online booking process was straightforward and the check-in was remarkably efficient.

However, I was somewhat disappointed by the hidden charges. The seat selection fee and carry-on baggage charges were not clear during booking. Greater transparency would be appreciated.

Additionally, the legroom was quite limited. While I understand budget constraints, slightly more space would improve comfort.

Furthermore, offering complimentary water on longer flights would be a welcome gesture.

The cabin crew were exceptionally friendly, which I greatly appreciated.

Yours faithfully,
A Budget Traveler
t12.sampleA1:
Hi SkyBudget!


My fly was okay. Check-in easy. Staff nice. I want water next time. Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Dear SkyBudget,


Thank you for the email. The booking was easy and the check-in was quick. The people on the plane were nice. But the seats were not very good because they were small. I was thirsty and I wanted some water but it cost money. I think you should give free water. I will fly again if the seats are better and there is free water.


Thanks,
A Customer
t12.sampleB1:
Dear SkyBudget Customer Relations,


Thank you for asking about my flight. Overall, it was okay, but there are some things I think you could improve.


The booking online was simple and checking in at the airport was fast, so that was good. However, I wasn't very happy about the extra costs. I had to pay extra for my bag, which I didn't expect. Also, the seats were a little uncomfortable because there wasn't much space for my legs.


I think it would be better if you made the baggage costs clearer when booking. Also, maybe you could offer free water on the flight. The staff were friendly and helpful. I would consider flying with you again if these things were improved.


Sincerely,
A Passenger
t12.sampleB2:
Dear SkyBudget Customer Relations,

I am writing to share my feedback following my recent flight with your airline.

To begin with, the online booking was refreshingly straightforward and the check-in ran smoothly, so credit where it's due. However, I was rather disappointed by the hidden charges. The fees for baggage and seat selection only came to light late in the process, which felt misleading. Greater transparency would go a long way.

In addition, the legroom was extremely tight, especially on a longer flight. A little more space would make all the difference, and offering complimentary water on longer routes would be a welcome touch.

On a positive note, your cabin crew were genuinely friendly and helpful throughout. With a few improvements, I would gladly fly with you again.

Yours faithfully,
Bekzod Aliyev

Onlayn bron qilish oddiy edi va aeroportda ro'yxatdan o'tish tez bo'ldi, shuning uchun bu yaxshi edi. Biroq, qo'shimcha xarajatlar meni juda xursand qilmadi. O'ylaymanki, bron qilishda yuk narxlarini aniqroq qilsangiz yaxshiroq bo'lardi. Shuningdek, parvozda bepul suv taklif qilishingiz mumkin. Xodimlar do'stona va yordam berishga tayyor edilar. Agar bu narsalar yaxshilansa, men siz bilan yana uchishni o'ylab ko'rardim.

Umumiy tajriba qoniqarli bo'lsa-da, e'tiborga loyiq va mijozlar ehtiyojini sezilarli darajada oshirishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar bor, deb hisoblayman.


Avvalo, onlayn bron qilish jarayoni nisbatan sodda va ro'yxatdan o'tish tartibi samarali ekanligini aniqladim. Biroq, qo'shimcha to'lovlar bilan bog'liq shaffoflikning yo'qligidan biroz hafsalam pir bo'ldi. Xususan, bagaj va o'rindiq tanlash uchun to'lovlar dastlabki bron qilish bosqichlarida yaqqol ko'rsatilmagan, bu esa biroz chalg'ituvchi tuyuldi.


Bundan tashqari, SkyBudget byudjet aviakompaniyasi sifatida faoliyat yuritishini tushunsam ham, oyoq uchun joyning cheklanganligi, ayniqsa uzoqroq parvozda sezilarli darajada noqulay edi. O'rindiq qadamining ozgina oshishi ham katta farq qiladi.


Va nihoyat, ayniqsa uzoq yo'nalishlarda bepul suv ta'minotini ko'rib chiqishni taklif qilaman. Ushbu kichik imo-ishora yo'lovchilar tomonidan juda qadrlanadi.


Shunga qaramay, parvoz davomida doimo do'stona va yordam bergan bort xodimlarini maqtashim kerak. Shaffoflik va yo'lovchilarning qulayligini biroz yaxshilash bilan, kelajakda sayohat qilish uchun SkyBudgetni tanlashga ko'proq moyil bo'lardim.


Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirli yo'lovchi
